responsibility: Contains PowerPC Darwin-specific RTL patterns that supplement the generic rs6000 machine description. Its patterns handle Mach-O relocation forms, low/high symbol addressing, PIC base materialization and correction, nonlocal goto PIC restoration, and some Darwin-specific load/store addressing cases, bridging generic rs6000 code generation with Mach-O and Darwin PIC conventions in final RTL expansion and reload.
same_name_distinction: This is the RTL-pattern member of the Darwin group: it implements Mach-O/Darwin-specific instruction patterns such as high/low relocations and PIC-base handling, rather than the macro/spec configuration in darwin.h or the option declarations in darwin.opt.
